dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Metro Transit tunnels
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Metro Transit tunnel polygon. Covers a portion of downtown Seattle.

Purpose: Developed to support transportation planning; transit planning; facilities; maintenance and operations within the Department of Transportation. Trip planners also use the data to assist Transit riders for trip planning.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
